_comment: Shared test vectors of the bundle manifest's rules: orchestrator/runtime/bundle/manifest.py (tests/test_llmcf_install.py) and rust/llmcf-install (src/manifest.rs tests) both check them. Only documentation names and addresses.

accept.why: a sysctl file of the component
a unit drop-in with its unit
a harness component with its run_harness action
a harness with its opted-in assume-yes switch
a harness without a dry run of its own and a sha256 pin
memory high and the out-of-memory order
the gateway may start and stop the bundle's engine units
the gateway may start and stop one engine unit
96 start arguments (the gateway with its speech and vision options and three engines)
engine units in turn: installed, started by the gateway on demand

reject.why: cgroup of a unit no install_unit makes
root file not of the component
install_unit of a component without start
run_harness for a component that is no harness
a harness component without its harness
a harness on an llm component
a harness tar that is online
a harness with a start of its own
a dry-run option that is shell text
an assume-yes switch that is shell text
an exit code with a leading zero
an exit code meaning something else
a harness id with upper case
an unknown key in the harness
a unit exempt from the out-of-memory killer
unit control of a unit that is no engine (the gateway's own)
unit control of a unit no install_unit makes
unit control of a unit outside the bundle
unit control with a unit twice
unit control for another account than the gateway's
unit control by a component that is not the gateway
unit control as a text, not a list
unit control without the gateway's own unit
unit control of an engine unit not named after its component
the gateway's own unit on demand (no engine)
an engine unit on demand that the gateway may not start
a unit on demand without the gateway's control
